# ANZ Bank New Zealand — Personal

> ANZ offers a wide range of personal banking and financial services in New Zealand, including bank accounts, credit cards, home loans, personal loans, insurance, KiwiSaver, investments and foreign exchange.

## Personal banking

- [Bank accounts](https://www.anz.co.nz/personal/accounts/): Everyday accounts, savings accounts and term deposits.
- [Credit cards](https://www.anz.co.nz/personal/credit-cards/): Compare ANZ credit cards.
- [Home loans](https://www.anz.co.nz/personal/home-loans-mortgages/): Mortgages and home lending, including paying off your loan faster.
- [Personal loans](https://www.anz.co.nz/personal/loans/): Borrowing options for personal needs.
- [Insurance](https://www.anz.co.nz/personal/insurance/): Personal insurance products.
- [KiwiSaver](https://www.anz.co.nz/personal/kiwisaver/): Retirement saving with ANZ KiwiSaver.
- [Investments](https://www.anz.co.nz/personal/investments/): Investment products and services.
- [Foreign exchange](https://www.anz.co.nz/personal/fx-international/): FX rates, calculators and international money transfers.

## Financial wellbeing

- [Financial wellbeing](https://www.anz.co.nz/banking-with-anz/financial-wellbeing/): Tools, tips and coaching to help manage money.
- [Scams and fraud guide](https://www.anz.co.nz/banking-with-anz/banking-safely/): How to recognise and avoid scams.
